vc.tierT.real: A real, distinct speaker – open-source voice running right in this browser
vc.tierT.variant: Timbre variant of a real speaker (same person, different colour)
vc.tierT.premium: Natural cloud voice via the operator’s speech service
vc.none: No voice for this language yet – the browser reads with its system voice.
vc.speaker: Speaker: {n}
vc.p.title: Agent voices
vc.p.sub: The voice customers hear – on the phone and in voice messages. At least six voices per language, woman and man.
vc.p.pool: No choice yet – the agent uses a fixed voice from the pool of its language.
vc.p.saved: Voice saved: {n}. The agent now speaks with this voice on the phone.
vc.p.phoneNote: Phone (Twilio): premium and browser voices are replaced on the phone by the closest natural Google HD voice of the same gender.
vc.p.langNote: The language follows the agent’s phone language (Phone → Voice / Language).
vc.p.noPlans: No agent set up yet – choose an agent under “Agents” first.
vc.p.premiumOff: Premium voices appear as soon as the operator has added a speech-service key.
